seams.reason: every raw call airlock makes: each system's sync, rename, unlink, close, identity, clone and map-flush calls, declared as the system documents them, and the mount table read to tell a refusal from a failure
heldBy reads the holder file git and airlock write beside a lock, its one input, handed straight to aegis.input.Untrusted and pid.parse
copyFrom moves a source file's bytes into the temp, never reading them as anything: a copy, not an input
the seam in front of every raw call: a call's code is the system's own, an errno on POSIX and an NTSTATUS on Windows
